title: SEC’s $75M Reg Crypto Plan Could Ignite Token Fundraising on Ethereum, Solana, BNB
summary:
Key Takeaways: Regulatory agencies proposed Reg Crypto for clearer guidelines on token fundraising. Grayscale believes there is upside to Ethereum, Solana and BNB Chain. Projects that will qualify may benefit
The post SEC’s $75M Reg Crypto Plan Could Ignite Token Fundraising on Ethereum, Solana, BNB...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Regulatory agencies proposed Reg Crypto for clearer guidelines on token fundraising.
  • Grayscale believes there is upside to Ethereum, Solana and BNB Chain.
  • Projects that will qualify may benefit from a fresh way of securing financing in the United States.

The new U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) crypto rule may revive a fundraising avenue that shifted offshore during the ICO boom years. The framework is the potential driver for more token issuance and blockchain activity in the U.S., said Grayscale.

  • SEC Targets a Long-Standing Crypto Fundraising Gap
    • Two Potential Fundraising Paths
  • Ethereum, Solana and BNB Chain Could Capture More Activity

SEC Targets a Long-Standing Crypto Fundraising Gap

The SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, or “Reg Crypto,” on August 18, following its March 2026 interpretation of how federal securities laws apply to crypto assets and transactions.

The proposal emphasizes newly minted tokens for fundraising, not tokenized shares of an existing stock or other securities. The difference here matters, because token financing has been around for a number of years, but given the regulatory uncertainty, many U.S. issuers have struggled to launch a token fundraising offering on their home domain.

According to nodes, the 2017–18 ICO cycle illustrated the extent of the demand for tokens from investors. Newer offers, such as initial exchange offerings and decentralized exchange offerings, began to trend increasingly off-shore from the U.S. as projects looked elsewhere for more favorable regulations.

Reg Crypto offered eligible issues a clearer route into the market and mitigated the advantage of structuring token offers abroad, said Grayscale Head of Research Zach Pandl.

Read More: SEC Eyes Tokenized Stocks Plan That Could Unlock Trillions in Crypto Trading Markets

Two Potential Fundraising Paths

The proposed framework provides exemptions which may permit projects with specific disclosure and eligibility requirements to attract capital. One option might allow for lower amounts of early-stage fundraising, while a wide open-ended exemption would allow all issuers that are a qualified issuer to raise $75 million in a 12-month period.

These are rules that are suggested, not actual permissions. Issuers will still have to meet the SEC’s conditions, and the framework will have to undergo the rulemaking process before it takes effect.

Ethereum, Solana and BNB Chain Could Capture More Activity

Grayscale claims that if its tokens are successfully funded, they will create activity outside of the issuers.

The more token releases the more users, transactions, liquidity and application use there would be on the public blockchains. The company pointed to Ethereum, Solana and BNB Chain as networks it believes would be well-positioned to improve should U.S. token issuance accelerate.

Another question that’s discussed again in Reg Crypto is what happens when the crypto protocol begins to be automated or decentralized enough. The proposal is based on SEC’s March 2026 guidance, and can offer a path for some qualifying tokens to transition from an investment contract status once the issuer’s promised managerial work is done.

Reg Crypto is not finalized by SEC and the final up to final requirements may evolve on the public rulemaking. Nonetheless, Grayscale sees the act as a possible groundbreaking move for introducing the token-based capital formation to the U.S. cryptocurrency market.

title: $1B FalconX-Ethena Deal Puts USDe Backing to Work
summary:
Key Takeaways: FalconX and Ethena introduced a $1B secured lending facility for institutional credit. Overcollateralized loans to an institutional borrower will be given from assets backed by USDe. With the
The post $1B FalconX-Ethena Deal Puts USDe Backing to Work appeared first on CryptoNinjas.
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • FalconX and Ethena introduced a $1B secured lending facility for institutional credit.
  • Overcollateralized loans to an institutional borrower will be given from assets backed by USDe.
  • With the addition of this new return source, Ethena offers a new opportunity to crypto-native strategies.

FalconX and Ethena are taking a major step toward bringing onchain capital deeper into institutional credit markets. The two firms announced the $1 billion facility on August 19, with the structure designed to deploy assets backing Ethena’s USDe into secured loans.

FalconX has partnered with @ethena on a $1 billion secured lending facility, deploying capital from the assets backing USDe into overcollateralized institutional credit.

The facility bridges Ethena’s crypto-native liquidity with FalconX’s institutional borrowing demand and marks…

— FalconX (@FalconXGlobal) August 19, 2026

The move adds institutional lending to the ways USDe-related capital can generate returns, expanding beyond crypto-native strategies.

  • $1 Billion Facility Targets Institutional Borrowers
  • Ethena Adds Institutional Credit to USDe’s Return Strategy
    • FalconX Becomes the Bridge Between Crypto Capital and Credit
    • Onchain Capital Moves Deeper Into Institutional Finance

$1 Billion Facility Targets Institutional Borrowers

The lending arrangement operates through a special purpose vehicle (SPV), allowing capital from assets backing USDe to be deployed into overcollateralized institutional loans.

FalconX will be the originator, the servicer and collateral manager for the loans. The securities will be held with qualified lenders in a structure that will safeguard the funds used to support the lending activity.

The facility is suitable for financing a number of finance use cases such as trading strategies, corporate treasury management and payment-related functions.

The amount of capital initially deployed, borrowers, loan terms or expected returns were not mentioned by either party. To account for the facility size, not that the $1 billion amount has been pumped into outstanding loans.

The structure, on the other hand, establishes a substantial capacity to extend loans, to be tapped as CIU opportunities arise.

Read More: FalconX and Interstice Launch $9T Cross-Chain Engine Linking Canton, Solana and Ethereum

Ethena Adds Institutional Credit to USDe’s Return Strategy

The partnership brings a new revenue flow to the USDe assets of Ethena.

USDe is a synthetic dollar built via a mixture of crypto-assets and hedging positions to hold a dollar exposure. Historically it has had close links with trade opportunities in the crypto sector such as basis and funding factors.

This will enable the new facility to earn capital returns in the absence of reliance on the market conditions of trading business. Overcollateralization means that borrowers need to put up assets that have more value than they are borrowing.

That does not remove risk. Performance can be impacted by the risk of borrower default, volatility of assets, circumstances of liquidation and exposure from counterparties.

Read More: Ethena Commits $250M to Securitize’s STAC as $1.3T CLO Market Expands to Solana

FalconX Becomes the Bridge Between Crypto Capital and Credit

The collaboration also broadens FalconX’s operations beyond relative conventional electronic asset trading and financing.

Institution-traded and financed trading and financing already have been enabled on FalconX for USDe. The new facility will enable it to link Ethena’s crypto-native liquidity with institutional borrowers looking for secured funding.

Onchain Capital Moves Deeper Into Institutional Finance

According to the announcement, this is a step towards beginning to link crypto liquidity to financial transactions that used to necessitate the help of banks and private credit providers.

As institutional orders for USDe gain ground, the facility will offer Ethena additional return options for USDe backing. For FalconX, it unlocks the ability to borrow more funds in the entire digital asset universe.
